group.name: Data Input Module <-> Processing Module
group.modules: input_module.py (parse_numbers, parse_edges)  ->  processing.py (build_linked_list, build_bst, build_graph, sort_and_search)  ->  linked_list / bst / graph / sorting
group.strategy: Bottom-Up Integration: the data-structure modules (already unit/component tested) are driven by processing.py, and then by the input parser on top.
group.dataPassed: Raw string "50, 30, 70" -> list[int] [50,30,70] -> BST/LinkedList;  "A-B:4, ..." -> list[(u, v, w)] -> Graph adjacency dict
